name: Pilot Level
desc: Overall experience as a pilot. Each level grants 1 attribute point to distribute freely.
notes: Level 30 cap = 29 attribute points to distribute over 6 stats (avg ~5 per stat). Combined with grow-by-use, a maxed pilot has ~8-10 in primary stats and ~4-6 in secondaries.

name: Experience
desc: Accumulated experience from missions, crafting, and exploration.
notes: EXP threshold scales linearly: level 1→2 = 100 XP, level 10→11 = 820 XP, level 30 = 2420 XP. Sources: combat (primary), task completion, exploration events. Resets to 0 on level up.

name: Attribute Points
desc: Unspent points from level-ups. Assign to any attribute at the Garage terminal.
notes: Accumulated but unspent points. Player can bank them or spend immediately. UI shows notification badge when points > 0.

name: Muscle
desc: Raw power. Drives melee damage, heavy weapon handling, and physical labor efficiency.
notes: Primary stat for Striker maneuvers. Melee builds want muscle 7+. The ATK contribution (×0.3) is the largest single-stat ATK modifier. Also contributes slightly to DEF (×0.1) — strong pilots absorb hits better.

name: Reflex
desc: Speed, coordination, and reaction time. Governs accuracy, evasion, and combat initiative.
notes: Secondary ATK contributor (×0.2) but PRIMARY accuracy stat. Reflex 8 = +16 accuracy, which is enormous. Key stat for Light frame pilots and long-range weapon users. Also determines turn order via initiative.

name: Focus
desc: Mental precision and concentration. Powers targeting systems, crafting quality, and energy management.
notes: Primary ENR contributor (×0.3). ENR fuels special actions and energy weapons. Also directly improves crafting speed. Tactician and Support maneuvers often require focus. The 'precision' stat — makes everything slightly better.

name: Grit
desc: Mental fortitude and physical endurance. Determines stress resistance, panic threshold, and damage absorption.
notes: THE defensive stat. DEF contribution (×0.4) is the largest single modifier to any derived stat. Grit 8 = +3.2 DEF, which is meaningful on any frame. Also determines stress cap — low grit pilots panic fast. Essential for Heavy frame pilots (high passive stress/turn) and Defender maneuvers.

name: Neuro
desc: Technical aptitude, system knowledge, and neural interface efficiency. Powers hacking, repairs, and tech weapons.
notes: Secondary ENR contributor (×0.2). The 'idle efficiency' stat — every point makes hacking, repair, dismantle, and research better. Support maneuvers often require neuro. Less impactful in direct combat but invaluable for the economic loop.

name: Charisma
desc: Social presence, negotiation skill, and leadership. Affects prices, reputation gains, and squad morale.
notes: Primary COR contributor (×0.3). COR determines panic resistance and crisis bonuses. Charisma 8 = +2.4 COR and -16% buy prices. The 'economy' stat — saves money and builds reputation faster. Least impactful in direct combat math but shapes the entire economic game. Grows slower than other stats (0.015 vs 0.02).

name: Reputation
desc: How well known you are in New Tokyo. Affects faction access, mission availability, and NPC reactions.
notes: Meta-stat. Not an attribute — a consequence of actions. Reputation 0-20 = nobody, 21-50 = known, 51-80 = respected, 81-100 = legendary. Different from faction-specific rep (rep_police, rep_military, etc.).
